description: This file manages storage and retrieval of execution webhooks, including registration, fetching, listing due webhooks, marking in-flight, updating state, and checking registration existence within a database.

classes.name: LocalStorage
classes.description: A storage handler for execution webhooks, providing methods to manage webhook data in a database.

methods.name: RegisterExecutionWebhook
methods.description: Stores or updates the webhook registration for an execution, inserting or updating the database record.

methods.name: GetExecutionWebhook
methods.description: Fetches the webhook registration details for a specific execution ID from the database.

methods.name: ListDueExecutionWebhooks
methods.description: Returns a list of webhooks that are pending and due for delivery, limited by the specified count.

methods.name: TryMarkExecutionWebhookInFlight
methods.description: Atomically marks a webhook as in-flight/delivering if it is pending and due.

methods.name: UpdateExecutionWebhookState
methods.description: Updates the delivery state, attempt counts, and errors for a specific webhook registration.

methods.name: HasExecutionWebhook
methods.description: Checks if a webhook is registered for a given execution ID.

methods.name: ListExecutionWebhooksRegistered
methods.description: Returns a map indicating which execution IDs have registered webhooks.
